question: Does none -> exact-v1 preserve full M1 state, control inputs, commands and outcomes through grasp/lift and mission completion while reducing retired instructions?
adoption_status: HOLD; none remains the default. This draft is not approval or evidence.

required_before_execution: Coordinator commits the final reviewed validator, reservation and recording implementation; freeze a clean candidate SHA before the first run.
Both conditions and all eight runs use the same SHA; only speedups differs.
Record execution bundle ID and hashes for runner, injected source bytes, scene, map, camera calibration, effective prereg and all amendments.
Implement and test every-step cumulative state recording and its continuity validator before registration. Current periodic single-state checkpoints do not meet this gate.
Register profiling through the standard sim_cli workflow management adapter and preserve the common execution/provenance record; select a new workflow version only after checking main and open PRs.
Commit the completed registration with candidate/environment/input hashes and the accepted execution budget. Do not mutate it during the cohort.

conditions.B_installation_gate: manifest speedups must confirm actual exact_drive_kernel plus contact_prefilter; fallback is not an acceleration-kernel test
conditions.approval_scope: Existing dev conditions retain their original approval status; this draft creates no new research-condition approval.

environment.host_scope: same Mac, M1 runner; freeze actual host/CPU/OS before execution
environment.opencv_threads: Freeze the existing baseline value identically in A and B; record actual cv2.getNumThreads().

execution.termination: Normal mission terminal condition or the unchanged runner SIM limit; never a 120-second or grasp/lift prefix stop.
execution.locks: Acquire the project exclusive agent_lock for the entire measurement cohort, plus shared sim_slots reservations; never stop other owners. All work runs from the frozen worktree.

budget_proposal_requires_registration.on_budget_exhaustion: Stop and report insufficient_evidence/HOST_ERROR, retain all originals; no automatic budget extension or deletion.

state_evidence.canonical_encoding: Record dtype, shape, byte order and robot ordering; hash exact contiguous bytes, step index and SIM time. No tolerances or float rounding in state bytes.
state_evidence.initial_state: Hash before the first physics step and record step 0 / exact SIM time.
state_evidence.every_step: Update a chained SHA-256 after EVERY actual mj_step, including warmup/initialization; count physical steps, not batched API invocations. No skipped intervals, state resets, untracked worlds or sampled-only substitutes.
state_evidence.terminal_state: Always flush the cumulative hash and exact final state/time/total step count at termination, including a partial final block.
validation: all physical steps included in the cumulative chain
total steps and final state/time match recorder and result
required phase coverage on both sides
state_evidence.control_boundary: State recording and phase reach checks are evaluator-only; no privileged state is fed back to controller/model input or success notification.

exactly_equal: original result.json bytes including every field
equivalence_gate.byte_policy: SHA-256 of original file bytes; do not normalize whitespace, key order, numeric encoding or missing versus null fields. Hashes do not substitute for completeness validation.
equivalence_gate.current_completeness_gate: M1 v3 file hashes match manifest; command/frame/contact/retention counts match result; frame indices, input/eval alignment and frame/GT cadence cover the episode; terminal command is hold followed by 0.5 SIM s settling. Last-step and termination state checkpoints must both be present and equal.
equivalence_gate.phase_validation: Current M1 log gate binds ordered result.phase_times skill:grasp, skill:to_carry_posture, skill:nav_preplace, skill:release, skill:look_back to control/eval frames, grasp/lift macros and skill events plus retention. Before registration bind each phase and actual door transit/placement outcome to the new cumulative state evidence; current phase labels alone do not establish physical success.
manifest_differences_allowed: explicit speedups setting and installation record
output path/provenance fields explicitly frozen in the registered comparison policy
equivalence_gate.missing_or_unreached: insufficient_evidence even when the same phase/window is missing on BOTH sides; never count as equivalent
equivalence_gate.baseline_repeat_mismatch: Hold adoption; no post-hoc tolerance, dropped JPEG, selective interval or successful-run-only analysis.

compute_gate.metric: full-episode process retired instructions, same instrumentation and measurement boundaries
compute_gate.aggregation: median of A1/A2 and median of B1/B2 separately for each seed
compute_gate.unavailable_or_invalid_counter: insufficient_evidence; do not substitute wall time
compute_gate.interpretation: Instruction reduction alone is not a demonstrated wall-time improvement.

failure_policy.behavior_failure_or_mismatch: Retain and report; no exclusion and no retry-until-success. Missing later phases block adoption.
failure_policy.replacement_order: Append the same condition/seed after the scheduled eight attempts; preserve the failed attempt and evidence for the infrastructure classification.
failure_policy.code_fix_after_mismatch: Register a new cohort with a new frozen SHA; never combine across fixes.

delivery.tensorboard: After actual completion/retrieval, create a NEW native TensorBoard snapshot under primary outputs/tensorboard, verify EventAccumulator values and video registration, show configured baselines/pinned metrics/HParams and the dashboard link. Preserve old snapshots.

adoption_scope.if_all_gates_pass: Evidence only for this Mac/M1/frozen execution bundle; default change still requires explicit review/approval.
